title: NebulaAPI rate limits
body: Public NebulaAPI endpoints enforce 120 requests per minute per client key. Responses include Retry-After when RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED is returned.

title: NebulaAuth token TTL
body: NebulaAuth access tokens expire after eight hours of inactivity. Enable silent credential refresh so tokens renew without interactive prompts.

title: Payments degradation runbook
body: When payments status is degraded, check card-auth latency and incident PAY-2041. Enterprise operators in us-east-1 may see slower checkout confirmations.

title: Canonical service names
body: Status tooling accepts canonical service names only: billing, payments, auth. Do not use aliases such as billing-api or billing-svc.
